name: Selects Clips
summary: Turn long videos into editable shorts with reference-inspired styles, captions and AI review.

compatibility.selects: Existing documented Panels APIs: call, askAI, runShell and runScript; native draft editing, generated-media authoring, frame capture, ordinary video export and workflow inspection. SDK declarations checked against installed Selects 2.0.430. Account must have plugin/generated-media authoring enabled. No host patch or private browser service. Python 3.9+, yt-dlp, ffmpeg and ffprobe required, plus Deno or Node.js 22+ for YouTube. Windows native end-to-end validation pending.
